name: Vacuum Shard (Handle Fragment)
description: Part of the ergonomic handle of the Vacuum of Eternity, worn smooth by the hands of legendary janitors

interactions.examine: The handle fragment is worn smooth from centuries of use by the First Janitors. When you look closely, you can see fingerprints etched into its surface - the ghostly impressions of all who wielded it before. It feels comfortable to hold, as if it was made for your hand specifically.
interactions.take: You pick up the handle shard. For a moment, you feel a connection to every janitor who has ever held it. It's humbling and slightly awkward.
